subject: Renewal kickoff — Novaproducts term stacking & QBR timing
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Cara Nguyen <cara.nguyen@novaproducts.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff — Novaproducts term stacking & QBR timing

Hi Cara —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our plan, I wanted to kick off a short renewal & expansion coordination thread so we can lock timelines, stakeholders, and a QBR window. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm whether you want to pursue a 12- or 24-month term (we can show a step-up pricing ladder either way).
- Confirm target uplift for peak tokens / concurrent throughput (I attached a capacity estimate we discussed).
- Provide legal point of contact for redlines and data residency questions.
- Propose 2–3 weeks for a QBR (we recommend a 60–90 minute session with product, infra, and procurement).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Novaproducts to confirm stakeholders + preferred QBR weeks.
2) Redwood to share a mutual action plan (MAP) and updated capacity estimate (attached).
3) If term change moves forward, Ben will coordinate commercial terms and DocuSign path.

Proposed QBR weeks: Apr 12–16 or Apr 19–23 (we can shift earlier if needed).

Attachment: Novaproducts_capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet — capacity scenarios + cost delta).

If helpful, I can lock a 30-minute pre-QBR sync with your infra/product before the full session.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Renewal Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: Cara Nguyen <cara.nguyen@novaproducts.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Ward <alex.ward@novaproducts.com>, Novaproducts Legal <legal@novaproducts.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 13:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — Novaproducts term stacking & QBR timing

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side:

- Term: leaning toward a 24-month commitment but want to see the staircase pricing and uplift math.
- Capacity: we expect a 40–60% uplift in token consumption during peak for the next 12 months, with occasional burst needs.
- Stakeholders: Alex Ward (CPO) for product, myself for program management, and I added Legal for contracts.

Legal asks: can you provide SOC 2 attestation, an updated data retention summary, and any audit logs export options? Legal@novaproducts will need those before they sign off.

QBR weeks: Apr 12–16 looks possible; Apr 19–23 is better for Alex. Can you hold both blocks for now?

Also want to get a draft MAP so our procurement team can map milestones internally.

Thanks —
Cara Nguyen
Head of Platform Strategy | Novaproducts
cara.nguyen@novaproducts.com

Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — Novaproducts term stacking & QBR timing

Cara — great, thanks for the quick clarity.

I attached a short MAP draft (mutual_action_plan_draft.md) that lines up milestones, owners, and target dates — feel free to iterate. I also pulled together the SOC 2 and data retention artifacts links below for Legal.

Ben Carter (cc'd) will lead commercial terms and intake for DocuSign; Ben, can you prepare a 24-month staircase price with the 40–60% uplift profile and an optional burst add-on? If we can, please include a sample SLA uplift for peak latency targets.

Action items we have now:
- Novaproducts: confirm final stakeholder list and preferred QBR date (Alex on Apr 19–23 looks likely).
- Redwood: Ben to send pricing + DocuSign path; Hannah to schedule QBR invite and prep deck; Karthik to coordinate infra-specific runbook for burst handling.

Links / artifacts for Legal:
- SOC 2 report (Redacted): https://secure.redwood.ai/soc2/2026-redwood-soc2.pdf
- Data retention and export options: https://docs.redwood.ai/compliance/data-retention
- MAP draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAP-draft-novaproducts

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_draft.md (text — MAP with milestones).

I'll pencil Apr 20 (Wed) 10:00–11:30 PT for the QBR and will send a calendar hold; we can pivot if Alex prefers a different slot.

Thanks all,
Hannah
Sr. Renewal Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi team — looping in on commercial next steps.

I'll have an initial 24-month staircase price and a burst add-on template in your inbox by EOD tomorrow. The pricing will include:
- Base committed throughput (tokens/month) with stepped increases at months 7 and 13
- Burst pool pricing (per-minute bucket) with a monthly cap option
- Optional SLA uplift for <100ms median token latency at the committed level (terms to be added to SOW)

I created a short poll for QBR slots — please vote for the best option: https://doodle.com/poll/novaproducts-qbr-2027

Ben Carter
